principles.status: Feature definitions/crosswalk considered; no positive implementation from a principle mapping alone.

scope_choices: All 35 PDF pages (main text, methods, references, and supplementary pages 18-35) were read as extracted text. All 6 main figure/table pages (3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10: Tables 1-3, Figures 1-3) were visually inspected via rendered PNGs during Phase E repair; supplementary figures/tables on pages 21-35 were reviewed via extracted text.

All patients in both the COMPORIV training (n=44) and temporal test (n=19) cohorts received a fixed activity of 7,400 MBq/cycle and none reached CTCAE grade 3-4 thrombocytopenia (Supplementary Table 7, p. 35); counterfactual reduced-dose and omitted-cycle simulations remain unvalidated against clinical outcomes.
The temporal validation cohort is small (n=19) and from the same centre (Institut Paoli-Calmettes), so external multi-site generalization is untested.
The legacy row was read from the root workbook (read only). Saved API drafts for B072 were not opened. The GitLab repositories stated in the paper were not inspected.
Schema validity and quote occurrence do not establish semantic correctness. No independent human review.
